config.subtitle: From docs/plan/GOALS.md (PRD v0.3, 10 Nov 2026). One developer, one lane. Columns are the earliest step a goal can start; work top-down within a column.

sizes.S: one short /goal session (half a day or less)
sizes.L: two or three sessions; the checkpoint carries you between them

config.workflowHint: Pick the top Ready goal and run /run-goal <ID>. A goal is Done only after goal-verifier passes every Done-when box and the branch is merged to main; a milestone only after its Exit checks pass.
config.refPlaceholder: branch or commit, e.g. goal/t-1-tenant-repo or 1a2b3c4
